probe_methods.name: Probe lock methods
probe_methods.description: Calls a list of local DLKLAP methods on the lock and returns the raw responses. Use it to discover whether the lock exposes an event-log method.

entry_id.name: Lock
entry_id.description: Config entry of the lock to probe. Probes all loaded locks if omitted.

methods.name: Methods
methods.description: Method names to call. Defaults to known methods plus candidate event-log methods.
